_about: The businesses the 'Ask us' website helper answers for (helper/ask.js on their site, helper/backend.gs answers). One entry per business; the key is the data-site the site's script tag uses (lowercase letters, numbers, dashes). Only facts the business gave us: the helper answers from these and nothing else. Changes go live within 10 minutes. active false switches a business off. dailyCap is questions a day (default 200).

demo-lawn.name: Lakeside Lawn & Snow
demo-lawn.tagline: A sample business made up for this demo: a family-run lawn care and snow removal company in La Porte County, Indiana.
demo-lawn.greeting: Hi! Ask me about our services, hours, the towns we cover, or how to get a quote.
services: Weekly and every-other-week mowing, April through October
Spring and fall cleanups, leaf removal
Aeration and overseeding in the fall
Snow plowing and salting for driveways and small parking lots, November through March
Seasonal snow contracts (every snow of 2 inches or more is plowed) or one-time plowing
demo-lawn.area: La Porte, Michigan City, Westville, Kingsbury, Rolling Prairie and Union Mills
hours: Office: Monday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM, Saturday 8 AM to noon
Crews work Monday to Saturday, weather permitting
Snow routes start when 2 inches have fallen, any time of day or night

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Call or text (219) 555-0142 or email hello@example.com with your address and what you need. Quotes are free, usually within one business day.
Yes, fully insured. A certificate of insurance is available on request.

faqs.q: What happens when it rains on my mowing day?
faqs.a: Rained-out mowing moves to the next dry day, usually within 48 hours. We text you when the crew is on its way.
A seasonal contract covers every snow of 2 inches or more from November through March. One-time plowing is available when there's room on the route.
Card, check or cash. Seasonal contracts can be paid monthly.

demo-lawn.notes: This is a made-up sample business for showing the helper. Prices depend on the property, so the helper never quotes a price.
